title: streak_restorer.dart redefines kBulkPriorSentinelMs as a local magic number instead of importing the existing core constant
rule: Evans (invariant enforced in one place) / Fowler (duplicated code, magic number)

evidence.quote:
// kBulkPriorSentinelMs (DateTime.utc(2000, 1, 1)); we define it locally to
    // avoid a core→features layering violation.

why: The comment's stated reason is wrong: SchedulerEngine.kBulkPriorSentinelMs (the thing it says it's avoiding importing) lives in features/scheduler, not core, so importing it would be a cross-feature import (Rule 2), not a core→features violation (Rule 1) — and the correct fix was available anyway: lib/core/learning/completion_constants.dart already exports this exact constant from core, which features/ may freely import, and its own doc comment explicitly says it 'MUST be excluded from... streak calculations.' The sentinel (2000-01-01 UTC ms) now has three independent definitions (core/learning/completion_constants.dart, features/scheduler/domain/services/scheduler_engine.dart, and this file) that can silently diverge if any one is edited, corrupting bulk-prior filtering in exactly one of streak restore, points history, or scheduler completion detection without any test catching the mismatch.
recommendation: Delete the local bulkPriorSentinelMs const and import kBulkPriorSentinelMs from core/learning/completion_constants.dart (a legal features→core import); fix the misleading comment.
acceptance_criteria: streak_restorer.dart imports and uses core's kBulkPriorSentinelMs; the local const is removed.
grep -rn '946684800000' lib/ returns exactly one hit (completion_constants.dart).

corrections: A 4th independent definition of this sentinel exists at features/onboarding/domain/services/bulk_prior_completion_service.dart:31-34 (with the identical flawed 'avoid core→features violation' comment) — not mentioned by the finding. The acceptance criterion 'grep returns exactly one hit' is unattainable via the stated fix alone; 2 hits (completion_constants.dart + bulk_prior_completion_service.dart) would remain.
